hook.text: Facebook's content moderation AI flags posts. Then 15,000 human reviewers decide. The AI processes scale.

buildup.text: Human-in-the-loop keeps humans as final decision-makers while AI handles filtering, sorting.

discovery.text: This approach catches AI errors before they cause harm. A flagged but not deleted post can still be reviewed and.

twist.text: The psychological cost is huge. Human reviewers suffer trauma from constant exposure to violent and disturbing content.

climax.text: Human-in-the-loop works at scale but creates new problems: reviewer burnout, inconsistency.

punchline.text: AI filters, humans decide. Scale and nuance together, at a human cost.

quiz.question: What is a human-in-the-loop system?
options: AI handles preliminary decisions while humans make the final judgment on flagged cases
